How PredictIQ works

PredictIQ reads the text produced by each customer — reviews, tickets, emails, call transcripts. It detects linguistic patterns associated with departure risk: word associations, recurring expressions, tone shifts. The result: a churn probability percentage per customer, updated after each new interaction.

3 risk clusters

🟢 Stable cluster — 0% to 40%

Neutral or positive language. No departure signal detected.

🟠 Watch cluster — 41% to 70%

Weak signals. Recurring frustration patterns. Monitor this month.

🔴 At-risk cluster — 71% to 100%

Strong departure signals. Competitor mentions. Rupture tone. Contact immediately.

3 use cases

Illustrative example

A CRM manager notices her best customers haven't ordered in 6 weeks. PredictIQ had flagged their departure signals 3 weeks earlier — email tone, declining contact frequency, competitor mention in a ticket. A targeted outreach with a personalized offer recovers 60% of at-risk customers.

Key verbatims that triggered the score

“second failed delivery” 68%“looking at alternatives” 79%“really disappointed” 71%

After each support call, PredictIQ recalculates the churn score. A customer whose billing issue wasn't resolved on the first call goes from 45% to 78%. The account manager is automatically alerted and calls back the next day — before the formal complaint.

Score progression

Call 1: 31%→Call 2: 45%→Call 3: 67%→Call 4: 84%

150 active clients. PredictIQ identifies 4 clients in the red cluster this month — without them having contacted support. Usage down 40%, last tickets contained disappointment signals. The CS team contacts them proactively, 3 weeks before the renewal date.
